title: Warm Chewy Venezuelan Coconut Pasta
description: A mustardy and chewy Venezuelan dish featuring coconut milk and pasta water emulsion, perfect for a hangover cure
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the pasta
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, mustard, and a pinch of salt and pepper
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to combine with the coconut milk mixture
Heat the olive oil in a large tava griddle over medium heat
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the thinly sliced onion and cook for 3 minutes until translucent
Add the pasta mixture to the tava griddle and stir to combine with the garlic and onion
Add some reserved pasta water to the tava griddle if the mixture seems too thick
Cook for an additional 2 minutes until the pasta is well coated with the sauce
